review_scope: All 40 intended-answerable questions and all 10 unsupported questions in each saved run. One evaluator reviewed the model answer, its printed citation labels, the full indexed chunks, the displayed quote where available, and the verified SEC source anchor. This is not a blinded or independent audit.

rubric.factual_accuracy: An intended-answerable response passes only if it answers the requested company, period, scope, and value without a material wrong claim. Abstention on an answerable question fails.
rubric.chunk_citation_precision: For each printed label in a substantive answer to an intended-answerable question, the cited indexed chunk must directly support the answer, including its period and scope. The citation is not rescued by a different retrieved chunk or by the filing as a whole.
rubric.displayed_quote_precision: For the improved system only, the exact displayed quote must directly support the answer, including period and scope. This is stricter than full-chunk support.
rubric.unsupported_refusal: An intentionally unsupported question passes only when the response declines to supply the unknowable answer.
